headline: Export manufacturers that benefited from high exchange rates... Warning signs for Q3 operating profit forecasts
summary: Korean export manufacturers face Q3 earnings risks as rising semiconductor prices and high oil prices raise costs. A falling won-dollar rate is also cutting the won value of export proceeds.
why: Korea's export sector is heavily exposed to semiconductors and global trade, so input costs and currency moves directly shape corporate earnings and the wider economy.
